description: This file is the main application component for a React-based single-page application (SPA). It sets up routing for various pages, including landing, login, signup, dashboard, explore, upload, viewer, admin, and a not-found fallback, with animated page transitions.

classes.name: PageTransition
classes.description: A React component that provides animated transitions for page content using framer-motion, managing opacity and Y-axis movement for entering and exiting pages.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React functional component that manages routing for the application with animated transitions.

methods.description: React component for wrapping page content with animated transitions.
